title: Astral Relay
pages: Craft this third t6 apparatus from a Ground Lens (from the Lens Grinder) and three sealed steel plates, a Solar Prism from the Heliostat Etcher, two redstone blocks, Lunar Essence from the Noctilucent Condenser and a resonance infuser. A bare fourth plate no longer works: the Lens Grinder's Ground Lens is now required alongside both predecessor outputs.

Provide a neighboring redstone signal and 20 FE/t, or charge by the manual crank. Removing the signal pauses progress without consuming FE. Two Lunar Essence relay into an Astral Core for the next progression gate.

Twenty datapack relaying recipes convert signal components, rails, lamps and conductive materials into useful devices. JEI shows input count, output, FE, duration and signal condition. Recipe type: arcana_industry:relaying; fields ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority.

Top and horizontal faces import only items accepted by a loaded relaying recipe; unmatched hopper items are rejected. Bottom exports. Change sides in the GUI. Inventory, FE, progress and port modes persist; breaking drops inventory.
Ten prismarine crystals relay into two sea lanterns; the five-crystal-per-lantern cost matches the best crystal recovery route.

Signal field: a relayed product may only carry the material traits of its inputs plus the live signal, which lends resonant equal to a third of its strength (rounded up, max 5) and luminous 1. A comparator needs strength 7 or more, a sculk sensor 10 or more; a redstone block always suffices. Too weak a signal shows 'Signal too weak' without spending FE. A datapack row whose product traits no signal can explain pauses with 'Product traits not in input or field'. Two tinted glass relay into a daylight detector.
